extraction.Name: Thelma Yeager
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 320 acre allotment when she got it, but that she was advised to take it by the Indian Agency, and she did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: got behind in her taxes, and, in 1924, it was sold by the County for the taxes, and pretty soon afterwards, they redeemed it by paying cash for those taxes
extraction.Buyer: sold by the County for the taxes
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in her taxes, and, in 1924, it was sold by the County for the taxes, and pretty soon afterwards, they redeemed it by paying cash for those taxes; at the present time, the only thing against it are the 1927-28 taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband, whose income is derived from farming
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; has four children who have good health; husband has good health; has never received any help from the County or Government; document subscribed and sworn November 19, 1928; allotment is 320 acres | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge (Oglala)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
